tactics._about: STYRAFIX (owner 2026-10-31: 'make styracosaurus bigger by like 3x'): the horned_charger profile (base, TacticalBrain.resolve) with its distances set for the 15 m body (its horn tip is ~6.8 m ahead of its centre), plus the impale charge. Every number an ASSUMPTION.

look: about 5 meter ceratopsian, barrel body on pillar legs, parrot beak, one long straight nose horn, big neck frill ringed by long cream spikes (longest at the top) with small edge spikes and cheek bosses, amber eyes, rust-red hide with broad cream-white tiger stripes on flanks and tail, greenish-grey belly and legs, cream horns with darker tips, dark hoof-claws,

pipeline.transplant_tool: tools/transplant_rig.py --hip-z 0.18 --shoulder-z 0.275 (the frill spikes fooled the shoulder measure, splayed feet the hip)
